[SWS_DM_02096] Provision of UDS addressing mode
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04170
⌈
The DM shall provide the UDS addressing mode (TAType) of the diagnostic request
(physical or functional) within metaInfo using the Key kTAType in all the subsequently
called ara::diag interfaces.
